counter_hypothesis.alternative: Retain GOV04 mandatory separate-context review because a same-agent second pass cannot provide equal process-independence assurance and can preserve correlated authoring errors.
counter_hypothesis.test: Compare the assurance property supplied by a fresh context with the GOV05 controls actually encoded at the frozen authoring head. The immutable checkpoint, mandatory reconstruction, counter-hypothesis, controls, gate preservation and fail-closed validator reduce confirmation risk but do not create independence. GOV05 therefore has to accept lower independence explicitly rather than claim equivalence.

active_controls: The frozen GOV04 Tier A, B, C and D gate inventories were compared against GOV05_REVIEW_ASSURANCE_MATRIX.json. The scientific gate sets are retained and only the review-process independence gate is replaced with an explicitly lower-assurance same-agent process.

The frozen B3Q01 disposition schema and representative Tier B and Tier C GOV04 review records were inspected. The legacy evidence.independent_review field does not itself force independence, so GOV05 can preserve the historical schema while requiring independent_from_correction_authoring=false plus a pinned GOV05 review artifact for same-agent use.

The branch scope was reconstructed from the B3D21 base. GOV05 changes only governance documentation, machine-readable GOV05 artifacts, its validator and its workflow; production source, frozen reference material, canonical TCD records and historical review/admission artifacts remain outside the permitted diff.
negative_controls: A same-agent record that sets independence_claimed=true must fail validation.
A matrix mutation removing a Tier C enhanced gate must fail validation.
A matrix mutation collapsing the Tier D production-authorization decision surface must fail validation.
A mutation promoting historical behaviour from UNKNOWN without B2 to KNOWN must fail validation.
A matrix mutation removing any frozen GOV04 Tier B gate from the preservation inventory must fail validation.
A SELF_REVIEW_PASS record containing a failed adversarial gate or an applicable failed scientific gate must fail validation.

The initial authoring checkpoint 82f3a6b089588ae64e9884492b145cef1f866128 failed closed in CI before a review artifact existed; its first adversarial inspection also exposed an underconstrained generic review schema, which was remediated before this restarted review.

SCIENTIFIC_GATE_SET_PRESERVED.justification: The matrix carries the exact frozen GOV04 gate inventories for Tier A through D and marks only the independent-context review-process gate as replaced. It explicitly forbids scientific evidence-gate removal.

SOURCE_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_ENFORCED.justification: GOV05 requires a complete persisted evidence package, immutable authoring head, source/testbank/evidence identities and pin verification before review. Frozen ANIMO source, testbank and guide SHA256 identities are recorded in status.

OWNERSHIP_UNITS_LIFECYCLE_ENFORCED_WHERE.justification: The policy requires same-agent review to reconstruct scientific ownership, variable identity, units, sign, lifecycle and first-read/first-write or restore direction whenever applicable, rather than inherit the authoring conclusion.

EXPECTED_DIFFERENCE_ENFORCED.justification: Expected-difference contracts remain explicit GOV04 scientific gates and are repeated as mandatory adversarial checks; no tolerance may be invented for Tier C.

CONSERVATION_ENFORCED_WHERE_APPLICABLE.justification: Conservation and accounting identities remain in the GOV04 gate inventories and in the mandatory second-pass reconstruction whenever scientifically applicable.

NON_INTERFERENCE_ENFORCED.justification: Non-interference is retained for Tier A through D as applicable and is explicitly required in the adversarial second pass and regression-surface inspection.

STATE_RESTART_NUMERICAL_GATES_ENFORCED_W.justification: Tier C retains state ownership, initialization/restart, numerical/convergence and failure/fallback gates and adds ownership reconstruction, restore-direction analysis, restart/split-run evidence where applicable, explicit comparison policy and no invented tolerance.

NEGATIVE_CONTROLS_AND_REGRESSION_ENFORCE.justification: The policy requires active and negative controls plus regression-surface inspection. The GOV05 validator contains explicit matrix and review-record mutation tests and a strict branch scope guard.

HISTORICAL_UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2_ENFORCED.justification: GOV03 remains pinned. The policy and matrix require historical revision-53 behaviour to remain UNKNOWN or UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2 when no qualified B2 exists; same-agent review cannot promote current-GNU or synthetic evidence to B2.

PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_SEPARATION_ENFO.justification: Tier D preserves separate immutable composition qualification, integration qualification, B4 decision and production-authorization surfaces. Ordinary authoring cannot authorize production, and GOV05 itself does not open B4 or production.

residual_uncertainty: Same-agent review retains correlated reasoning and confirmation-bias risk. Immutable checkpoints and adversarial prompts constrain that risk but cannot make the process independent.
GOV05 therefore has lower independence assurance than the GOV04 separate-context model. It provides neither human nor organizational independence.

B3Q01 retains the historical field name evidence.independent_review. For GOV05 same-agent use, a workunit-specific validator must enforce independent_from_correction_authoring=false and require the pinned GOV05 review artifact so the legacy name cannot be misread as an independence claim.

The generic GOV05 schema can enforce review boundaries, structured applicable scientific-gate results and Tier C/D minimum structures, but it cannot know every workunit-specific scientific gate. Each consuming workunit still needs a scope-specific validator that proves its applicable gate inventory is complete.

Transition observations are a dated snapshot. Any open handoff or in-flight GOV04 review must be rechecked live when a transition action is actually taken; no snapshot entry itself authorizes cancellation or converts a historical result.
This review PASS is a same-agent process result only. GOV05 qualification remains conditional on the exact final-head workflow succeeding after this review record and final status are committed.
